items.title: OpenAI pushes agentic math research
items.oneliner: OpenAI reportedly ran 10,000 agents for 88 hours on a Millennium problem. Parallel research agents are getting real.

items.title: Suno ships a much faster music model
items.oneliner: Suno says v6 is 5x faster than v5.5 and edits sections in plain English. Creative iteration just got cheaper.

items.title: OpenAI targets financial analyst workflows
items.oneliner: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services with premium datasets, citations, and pitchbook workflows. Vertical AI is hardening.

items.title: Anthropic discloses biological misuse cases
items.oneliner: Anthropic disclosed five Claude misuse cases tied to potential weapon development. Safety reporting is finally getting concrete.

items.title: WebGPU can freeze Macs from websites
items.oneliner: A malicious WebGPU shader can freeze macOS browsers with one click. Browser GPU sandboxes still have sharp edges.

items.title: Forgejo patches a critical RCE
items.oneliner: Forgejo 16.0.4 fixes a critical remote code execution bug. Self-hosted dev infrastructure remains a high-value target.

items.title: LG TV spying claims escalate
items.oneliner: LG TVs are accused of recording audio and video even when off. Smart home threat models keep getting uglier.

items.title: NVIDIA expands Australian AI capacity
items.oneliner: NVIDIA plans up to 2 gigawatts of Australian AI data center capacity by 2027. Power is now the scaling bottleneck.

items.title: ClickHouse lessons from petabyte scale
items.oneliner: After five years at petabyte scale, one operator says ClickHouse setup is easy but operations are where costs hide.

items.title: Payments firms propose agent trust rails
items.oneliner: Visa, Mastercard, and Ant are building an AI agent trust framework. Commerce wants identity and liability before autonomy.
